cases.scenario: Rejected TCP spelling variants, relative and empty Unix paths, and a directly tampered persisted non-loopback handoff.
cases.expected: Only absolute Unix paths and exact loopback endpoints are accepted; persisted handoffs are revalidated.

cases.scenario: Concurrent recordCodexWakeEvent calls and malformed/path-like wake acknowledgement keys. Re-run after per-event withFileLock fix: exactly one created:true, ack idempotent, malformed keys rejected.
cases.expected: At most one concurrent caller reports created:true; acknowledgement is idempotent; malformed keys are rejected.

cases.scenario: Token-file publication, state-root secret scan, unreadable token error, and raw token MCP registration argument.
cases.expected: Only token-file references persist; the token is absent from state and errors; raw token input is rejected.

cases.scenario: Control-character and 100KB summary injection plus a turn record containing a final_response sentinel.
cases.expected: Wake prompt is whitespace-normalized and bounded, and never contains final_response text.

cases.scenario: Non-exact idle status response shapes and a throwing thread/resume transport.
cases.expected: turn/start occurs only after {status:'idle'}; publish errors create failed wake state with snake_case error code.

cases.scenario: Suffix, prefix, extended-token, Unicode-homoglyph, and 1MB prompt variants; canonical skill set assertion. Re-run after symmetric ASCII boundary fix; ultragoal keyword adjacency recorded as waived pre-existing behavior (W3).
cases.expected: Only the exact delegate-flow token persists host context and no spoofed token activates a workflow; workflow set remains four canonical skills.

cases.scenario: Read-only /Users/probe/.codex mtime check and git status allowlist after the suite.
cases.expected: Tests do not modify /Users/probe/.codex and introduce no changes outside the known bridge change set plus permitted QA artifacts.

findings.title: Concurrent wake recording is not atomic
findings.evidence: Fixed by wrapping record/update/ack in withFileLock per event file with terminal acked state; redteam suite now asserts exactly one created:true under Promise.all x5 and passes.

findings.title: Delegate-flow suffix spoof persists context and activates ultragoal
findings.evidence: Boundary regex now uses symmetric [^A-Za-z0-9_-]; uppercase/digit adjacency no longer matches. '$gjc-mcp-delegate-flow$ultragoal' activating ultragoal via the 'ultragoal' keyword is pre-existing keyword behavior, recorded as waiver W3 in the ultragoal ledger.
